_comment: Offset table produced during the research phase. All values below are illustrative placeholders from a hypothetical target, not real offsets.

_how_to_obtain.MATRIX_OFF: android_tools.py scan / chain on the view-projection matrix
_how_to_obtain.ENTITY_BASE: absolute address after resolving the entity list pointer chain
_how_to_obtain.POS_OFF: offset of the vec3 position inside one entity
_how_to_obtain.HEALTH_OFF: offset of the float health field
_how_to_obtain.TEAM_OFF: offset of the int team id
_how_to_obtain.BOX_RATIO: box width / box height, typically 0.5 for humanoids
